meta.name: apollo-security-basics
meta.description:
Apply Apollo.io API security best practices.
Use when securing Apollo integrations, managing API keys,
or implementing secure data handling.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo security", "secure apollo api",
"apollo api key security", "apollo data protection".

copy.tagline: 保护好 Apollo 接口密钥与客户数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在接入 Apollo 接口时担心密钥和数据安全。
copy.tagline_en: Protect your Apollo API keys and customer data from leaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're integrating Apollo APIs and worry about keeping keys and data secure.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按 Apollo.io 安全规范管理 API 密钥、保护数据、控制访问,并输出安全审计清单和配置步骤。
howto.when: 当你说出“apollo security”“secure apollo api”“apollo api key security”等短语,或要求保护 Apollo 集成、管理 API 密钥、安全处理数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我按 Apollo 安全最佳实践检查 API 密钥管理方式。
say.note: Claude 会开始安全审查并给出建议。

say.text: 给 Apollo 集成做日志 PII 脱敏,保护个人数据。
say.note: 处理日志中的个人身份信息泄露。

say.text: 生成一份 Apollo 集成安全审计检查清单。
say.note: 输出可执行的审计清单。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude applies Apollo.io API security best practices: it reviews API key management, data protection, and access controls, then outputs a security audit checklist and configuration steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like 'apollo security', 'secure apollo api', 'apollo api key security', or ask to secure Apollo integrations, manage API keys, or handle data securely.

say_en.text: Review my Apollo API key management against security best practices.
say_en.note: Claude will start a security review and provide recommendations.

say_en.text: Set up PII redaction for Apollo integration logs to protect personal data.
say_en.note: Handles personal data leaks in logs.

say_en.text: Generate a security audit checklist for our Apollo integration.
